name: Frostwood
_doc: A 1v1 winter map (P3-23): pine forests split the ground into lanes, a logging village sits between the northern bases, and a frozen lake whose thin ice holds no one fills the south middle. Mirrored across x = 128 (terrain_gen.mirror_x makes the heights exact).
_terrain_doc: height.r16 is built from terrain_gen by tools/make_heightmap.py: rolling snowfields and the lake carved in the south middle (below water_level_cm: impassable).
_obstacles_doc: Pine forests [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m], west side first, then their mirrors.
_civilian_doc: Logging village houses [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m, roof_height_m]: neutral buildings that block movement and that infantry can garrison (P3-05).
_neutral_doc: Capturable neutral buildings [building_id, x_m, y_m] (P3-08a), centered on the point; west side first, then mirrors, then any on the middle line.
_supply_doc: Per side: a safe site by the base, a south-west expansion, one on the south shore, and a contested one by the village.
